name: Iron Warden
text_md: Iron wardens are sworn guardians who bond themselves to a single fortification and never willingly leave it undefended.

class_features.name: Bulwark Stance
class_features.text_md: While standing his ground, an iron warden grants adjacent allies a +2 shield bonus to Armor Class.

class_features.name: Unyielding
class_features.text_md: An iron warden cannot be moved from his square against his will while standing his ground.

class_features.name: Fortress Bound
class_features.text_md: An iron warden gains damage reduction 2/-- while within his bonded fortification.

description_sections.heading: Requirements
description_sections.text_md: To qualify to become an iron warden, a character must fulfill all of the following criteria.

fields.weapon_and_armor_proficiency: Iron wardens gain no proficiency with any weapon or armor.
